name: curavo
description: Find public Curavo collections, explore their recommendations, and open shareable guides. Public read-only access; no private workspace access or saving through ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Find publicly shared Curavo collections of places, ideas, shopping recommendations, and more. Search by keyword or category, read real collection entries and links, and open a published guide on the Curavo website. Results depend on what people have published. This integration is read-only: it cannot access private notes or personal workspaces, create or edit collections, or save information to Curavo through ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Find public Curavo collections about Tokyo.
Open the entries in this public Curavo collection.

positive.prompt: Find public Curavo collections about Tokyo.
positive.expected_behavior: Return published Tokyo-related Curavo collections from the live database, with titles and valid links. Never invent collections.
Return real Fashion-category results if available; otherwise give an honest empty response.

positive.prompt: Find Curavo collections for Tokyo in the Fashion category.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply the keyword and category constraints and return only genuinely published matches.

positive.prompt: Show the entries in a published Tokyo Curavo collection found in the search results.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the actual returned public ID and its current entries without assuming an item count or inventing details.

positive.prompt: Give me the shareable website link for a published Tokyo collection from the results.
positive.expected_behavior: Verify that the returned ID is still public and return its canonical HTTPS /discover/list/ID URL.

publication.release_notes: Submission packaging for the existing Curavo Plugin 0.1.1: public search, collection retrieval and verified public links. Adds prepared website privacy, support and terms URLs and review materials. The MCP server and its three read-only tools are unchanged.
